# v2026.11.12

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.12.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.12.md).

This release covers **3 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A Link or Unlink holds while the matcher runs: a pass that read the job before the change no longer saves a stale "not found", or puts the old invoice back. ([#523](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/523))
- One-off Seazona reads through Flow (by a person or an agent key) take at most 10 a minute, so Flow's own sync always keeps its share of Seazona's limit. ([#524](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/524))

## Fixes

- A matcher pass saves what it found only when the job still has the invoice it read; otherwise the next pass checks the job again. ([#523](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/523))
- A Seazona read over 10 a minute answers 429 with the wait and never reaches Seazona. ([#524](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/524))
